text: Ask people to narrate trades, not merely complete them; the reasons are the exercise.
Pause if a word is carrying different meanings for different participants and make those meanings explicit.
Leave time to discuss the cards nobody sought and the values participants wished were present.
Do not resolve uncertainty for the group; ask participants what would justify acting despite it.
Track who speaks, whose evidence enters proposals, and where informal authority emerges.
In the debrief, separate criticism of the outcome from criticism of the process that produced it.
